decisions.reason: The ETH-specific Uniswap swap and ETH refund policy does not change the separate Transak fiat-to-USDC purchase and fulfillment flow.
The decision changes conversion of ETH into exactly 15 USDC, not the direct wallet-funded USDC mint flow.
Obtaining exactly 15 USDC and refunding unused ETH does not alter the established $15 price or allocation of primary-mint proceeds.
The ETH swap and refund mechanics do not affect embedded wallet provisioning or reward access for fiat buyers.
The source changes execution within the already enabled ETH payment path and does not change which payment methods are available or how they are selected.
Primary-mint ETH conversion and refund behavior does not change secondary-sale royalty amounts, enforcement, or marketplace policy.
The source decision does not mention or necessarily alter optional tipping behavior or tip amounts.
The existing FAQ state does not encode the prior USDC excess-refund mechanism, and the source does not require new FAQ disclosure.
Changing ETH swap and refund mechanics does not necessarily change NFT metadata, image rendering, ebook links, or wallet asset display.
The landing-page hero state contains no ETH conversion or refund claim requiring revision.
The ETH payment conversion method does not change recipient selection or reward components for no-referral and invalid-referral mints.
The About-page content does not specify the prior ETH swap-output refund rule, and the source decision does not entail a content revision.
